summary: Live verification of Sage home and workspace against Raspberry Pi server

network.static: Home/workspace resources loaded; favicon 404 only expected static error

behavior.todo: PASS: returned card rendered; first item click changed aria-pressed from false to true and data-done to true
behavior.quiz: PASS: Queue selection set aria-checked=true; Reveal answer produced Correct feedback and disabled Answer revealed
behavior.chat_mermaid: FAIL: explicit recursion message streamed, but auto Mermaid output returned 422 mermaid_invalid and UI showed generic Diagram unavailable card/status rather than documented validator-unavailable fallback or Illustrated by Sage
behavior.explicit_diagram: FAIL/ENVIRONMENT: button request returned 422 invalid_json after long cold-start wait; UI displayed Diagram unavailable. This is model/structured-output environment failure, not a client crash.
behavior.artifacts_rail: PASS: rail opened with cards at desktop; CSS bottom-sheet/overlay remained open at 640 and 768; Close artifacts control accessible
behavior.offline_mermaid: FAIL: blocking Mermaid CDN caused ReferenceError: mermaid is not defined at inline page script line 956; the unguarded `if (mermaid)` global access is a real page error

console_errors: two output endpoint 422 responses from Mermaid generation
offline probe: net::ERR_FAILED for Mermaid CDN and ReferenceError: mermaid is not defined
final_report: Live Playwright verification executed against the user's running Raspberry Pi server without starting a server or modifying production source. Home and workspace passed one-h1, no-overflow, and interactive-control checks at 640/768/1024/1280. Session creation, todo output/card and checkbox behavior, quiz output/selection/reveal, outputs network calls, and artifacts rail responsiveness passed. Auto Mermaid chat and explicit Diagram produced documented server-side structured-output failures (422 mermaid_invalid/invalid_json), with generic unavailable UI. Blocking the Mermaid CDN reproduced a concrete client defect: ReferenceError: mermaid is not defined from `if (mermaid)`; offline Mermaid handling does not meet the requested no-page-error criterion. Verdict FAIL.
notes: No oc-issues entry appended: the 422 Mermaid responses are expected environment/model fallback behavior, while the offline ReferenceError is an application defect. Existing Turing changes were not altered.
